tools.name: list_recent_signals
tools.title: List recent signals
tools.description: Return the most recent forex scalping signals generated by ScalpEdge. Optionally filter by pair, direction, or status. Returns entry, stop, TP levels, R:R, confidence, setup, and execution status.

limit.description: Max number of signals to return (default 10).

pair.description: Filter by trading pair, e.g. EUR/USD.

status.description: Filter by signal status (pending, active, tp1, tp2, sl, expired, ...).

tools.name: signal_stats
tools.title: Signal performance stats
tools.description: Aggregate performance stats for ScalpEdge signals over a rolling window: total signals, win rate (TP1+), average R multiple, and breakdown by setup.

tools.name: get_scan_gates
tools.title: Get scan engine gates
tools.description: Return the current ScalpEdge scan engine filter gates: minimum confidence, minimum R:R, minimum ADX, trail lock-in, and VERITAS thresholds. These are the live values scan-signals reads at the start of every cycle.
